correctness.rationale: The uniform substitution factor lemma covers every length-n factor with the four morphic blocks mu^m(ab), m=ceil(log2 n): any n-window meets at most two aligned blocks and all four adjacent bit pairs occur in Thue--Morse. Independent generation confirmed |F4|=10, |F6|=16 and |F8|=22. For any group merging only one pair of factors, some member permutation generates a cyclic subgroup merging the pair but no others. Independently enumerating all 4!=24 and 6!=720 single permutations and their induced cyclic orbit intersections excluded class counts 9 and 15. Independently reimplemented subgroup generation for each explicitly listed W4/W6 generator witness and matched every displayed attainable complexity. Applying (1 2)(3 8)(4 5)(6 7) at n=8 produced exactly one merged factor pair, 01001011/10110100, so p=21. This proves only the finite exact spectra and one length-eight recovery, not an infinite even-length theorem.
residual_risks: Finite exhaustive verification is restricted to its specified domain.

value.rationale: Group complexity is a recognized invariant between factor and abelian complexity. Exact attainable spectra at the first nontrivial even lengths identify genuine gaps and their disappearance at length eight; this sharp boundary corrects the temptation to extend the known odd-length antipodal obstruction unchanged. Finite but fully classified spectra are natural and independently usable.
residual_risks: The value is finite or parameter-specific and should not be promoted as an all-parameter theorem.

final_claim: For Thue--Morse length-four and length-six factor sets, exact attainable group-complexity spectra omit the penultimate values 9 and 15; at length eight an explicit involution achieves 21 of 22 factor classes.
limitations: The two even-length spectra are finite n=4,6; only p=21 witness at n=8, not entire n=8 spectrum.
